sign_rule: Shadow prices are as each operator prints them: SPP's negative, CAISO's positive. Ranks, means and highs use the size of the price (its absolute value).
cost_rule: A constraint's cost here is its shadow price summed over the hours it bound (USD/MWh times hours), a ranking of how often and how dearly it bound; no flow is published, so no dollar total is made.
share_rule: A month's congestion share is its mean congestion part over its mean LMP, times 100; none when the mean LMP is not above zero.

operators.name: ERCOT
operators.why: ERCOT publishes its shadow prices only on paths its robots file disallows, or through an API whose key has not been made (the owner's ruling of 6 November 2026)

operators.name: PJM
operators.why: PJM's terms forbid non-members to republish its data

operators.name: NYISO
operators.why: NYISO's terms reserve its data; written permission needed

operators.name: MISO
operators.why: MISO's terms forbid automated access; the ERW paused it on 4 October 2026

spp.prices: SPP, Day-Ahead LMP by Settlement Location (portal.spp.org, da-lmp-by-settlement-location)

caiso.constraints: California ISO, OASIS PRC_NOMOGRAM (nomogram and branch shadow prices, DAM)
caiso.prices: California ISO, OASIS PRC_LMP (DAM: LMP, energy, congestion, loss, greenhouse gas)
